item.title: Shining under pressure: Anthracite artist honors family with jewelry business
item.description: Jessup resident Constance Denchy descends from four generations of anthracite miners. Denchy honors this history by using anthracite in a different way: to make jewelry.

item.title: LOCAL COLLEGES: Lady Royals romp to another victory
item.description: Three players scored in double figures as the University of Scranton women’s basketball team remained unbeaten with a 76-35 win over Drew University in Landmark Conference action Wednesday at the John Long Center. Katie Gorski scored 19 points for the second-ranked Lady Royals (11-0 league, 18-0 overall). Elizabeth Bennett added 18 points and eight rebounds, while Kaci Kranson contributed 16 points. item.title: D2 WRESTLING: Abington Heights advances to Class 3A final
item.description: HAWLEY — Abington Heights coach Gregory Theony stressed one thing to every wrestler who stepped on the mat — do your job. Chace Berry took that to heart. Even with the Comets leading by 16 points over Wallenpaupack after five bouts, the Abington Heights sophomore stayed focused on his role. Berry’s four-point second period fueled a two-point decision victory over Kyle Scartelli to keep the line moving. item.title: County, state legislators criticize proposed Archbald data centers
item.description: Lackawanna County Commissioner Bill Gaughan urged Archbald officials to consider the countywide impacts of data centers Wednesday night while state Rep. Kyle Mullins unequivocally opposed a proposal to build more a dozen data centers above Business Route 6.

item.description: HAZLE TWP. — As anticipated, not much separated Pittston Area and Hazleton Area in their District 2 Class 3A wrestling duals semifinal Wednesday. item.title: Today in History: January 29, Bush warns of ‘axis of evil’
item.description: President George W. Bush said terrorists were still threatening America — and warned of “an axis of evil” consisting of North Korea, Iran and Iraq.

item.title: US appeals court says Noem’s decision to end protections for Venezuelans in US was illegal
item.description: The decision will not have any immediate practical effect after the Supreme Court in October allowed Noem’s decision to take effect pending a final decision by the justices.
